# Pat Lib Online
> LLM-first UI pattern library with deterministic retrieval contracts and lossless raw artifact transport.

## Canonical Entry Points

- Root: `/`
- LLM UI index: `/llm`
- Machine index: `/api/llm/index`
- Root JSON index: `/llm-index.json`
- Contracts API: `/api/llm/contracts`
- Health API: `/api/llm/health`

## Retrieval Strategy

### Minimal-Token Route (recommended)
1. Read `/api/llm/index?format=compact`.
2. Query `/api/llm/search?q=<task>&scope=all&mode=prompt|code&format=compact`.
3. Resolve only selected records with projected fields:
   - `/api/llm/patterns/{id}?packOnly=true&fields=id,name,objective,modes.code.implementationRawHref,modes.code.implementationHash`
   - `/api/llm/playbooks/{slug}?packOnly=true`
4. Pull only needed reference chunks:
   - `/api/llm/references/{id}/sections`
   - `/api/llm/references/{id}/sections/{sectionId}`

### Deterministic Route (full control)
1. `/api/llm/index`
2. `/api/llm/patterns` + filters (`q`, `mode`, `industry`, `category`, `tag`, `limit`)
3. `/api/llm/playbooks`
4. `/api/llm/references`
5. `/api/llm/contracts`

## Lossless Raw Artifact Endpoints

- Pattern TSX source: `/api/llm/raw/patterns/{id}.tsx`
- Reference markdown source: `/api/llm/raw/references/{id}.md`

Raw endpoints return `text/plain` without HTML sanitization.

## Query Controls (Token Efficiency)

Supported on collection/detail retrieval endpoints:
- `format=full|compact`
- `packOnly=true|false` (alias for `format=compact`)
- `fields=comma,separated,projection`

## Stable Identifiers

- Human pattern ID: `1.4`
- Canonical pattern ID: `patlib.pattern.1.4`
- Canonical route: `/api/llm/patterns/1.4`

## Prompt Composer

- Compose builder-ready lovable prompt:
  - `POST /api/llm/compose/lovable`
  - body: `playbookSlug`, `selectedPatternIds[]`, `variables`
  - output: `prompt` + `assumptions`

The composer enforces:
- no invented claims
- no placeholder output

## Human Navigation

- `/library`
- `/playbooks`
- `/reference`
